cover_letter_text:
Hi Hawk Geo team,

I'm Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 and I'm after a start in geotechnical and construction materials testing. Your advert says no experience is needed and you train people up, which is what I'm looking for.

In the diploma I studied soil testing standards (AS 1289). On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and kept records and reports. I'm organised and dependable.

I'd move to the Newcastle area and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Hawk Geo Pty Ltd is a Leading geotechnical and construction materials testing company servicing the Sydney, Central Coast and Hunter regions.
We are currently looking for a reliable and motivated Casual Laboratory Technician to join our team at our Boolaroo laboratory.
No previous experience is required. Full training will be provided.
This is a casual position, with the opportunity for a full-time traineeship for the right candidate.
About the Role
You will be trained to carry out a range of geotechnical and construction materials laboratory testing.
Your day-to-day duties will include:
- Preparing and testing soil and construction material samples
- General laboratory duties
- Recording and entering test results
- Maintaining a clean and organised work area
- Assisting other laboratory staff as required
As your skills and experience develop, you may also have the opportunity to gain exposure to:
- Field density testing
- Construction site testing and sampling
- Soil and materials sampling
This is a hands-on and physically active role that would suit someone who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new skills.
What We’re Looking For
To be successful, you will need:
- A current Australian driver's licence
- Reliable transport to and from our Boolaroo laboratory
- Availability to work Monday to Friday between 7:00am and 5:00pm
- The ability to repetitively lift up to 20 to 30 kg
- A practical and logical approach to problem solving
- Basic computer skills
- A strong work ethic
- Good communication skills
- The ability to work well in a team
- Reliability and punctuality
Previous experience in geotechnical testing, laboratories, construction or a similar industry is an advantage, but not essential.
We are looking for someone who is willing to learn, works hard and can be relied upon to turn up each day ready to work.
Why Join Hawk Geo?
- No experience necessary
- Full on-the-job training provided
- Opportunity to develop technical laboratory and field-testing skills
- Exposure to the construction and geotechnical industry
- Opportunity to progress into a full-time traineeship
- Work with a growing local team
If you are reliable, practical and keen to learn, apply now with your resume.
